description: Governed observation of the package: joinspec.md's three clauses (', ' separator, given order, empty list -> empty string), joiner.py's single line ', '.join(reversed(items)), and the six probes of probes.json. Grounds the per-probe determination comparison for E-A.

E-A behavior statement: enumeration of every probe-exercised behavior (separator, multi-item ordering, singleton rendering, empty-list rendering) with per-probe spec-determined vs joiner.py outputs; identifies multi-item ordering (probes 1, 3, 5) as the sole divergently-determined behavior and gives an explicit completeness argument that no probe-exercised behavior is undetermined. Authored in-session as a product of this analysis and excluded from the child's input manifest.

Clean-room child bundle proposed as observable artifact: attenuated terminal contract (Read+Write, max_children 0, 1 model call), four-node child harness, standalone prompt instructing implementation of inputs/joinspec.md alone as impl.py exposing join_items(items), input manifest containing exactly package/artifacts/joinspec.md (excluding joiner.py, probes.json, and every product of this session's analysis, satisfying E-B's authorship condition), and a pre-committed deterministic integration rule mapping impl.py to divergent_probe_indices and verdict.
